description: Check a list of business partners with the same fuzzy matching as the Insolvenzmonitor monitoring. Per customer: status match/no_match, the matching companies (one entry per company, best first) with confidence, how it matched (match_basis) and the proceeding stage, and `ambiguous` when more than one company matched. Send the 5-digit ZIP (PLZ) if known — with a ZIP, a name match only counts if the ZIP appears in the notice. Needs an API key; batch size and history depend on the plan (Trial: 5 customers, last 24 months).
name: check_customers
title: Kundenliste prüfen
